about: Research topics for the local model (tools/agents/local/idle_research.py), taken in order whenever Ollama has been idle 10+ minutes. Status: open, running, review (report written; Claude or ChatGPT checks it against the source), done, failed. Sources: Core3-dev paths relative to MMOCoreORB, or h: paths in the project, each with an optional :START-END line range; about 120,000 characters per topic at most. Anyone may add an open topic. Topics with "kind": "map" are chunk jobs (local_jobs.py names them; local_map.py runs them one chunk at a time and they resume after a pause).
